sourceFixture.method: Independent GET only; no POST, questionnaire submission, registration or vendor contact. PDF whitespace normalized, exact statements and source order preserved; twenty live form prompts independently matched.
sourceFixture.instructions: For each question 1-20, in the blank provided rate the item on a scale from 1 to 5 on how much you agree with the statement. For example, if you agree completely with question one put down a five in the empty space, if you entirely disagree with it put down 1, if you are neutral or unsure put down a 3.

items.prompt: I do not need others praise.
I would prefer a class in mathematics to a class in pottery.
I never show up late.
I don't bother to the read instructions before I start putting something together.
I could not live in a mess.
I am totally random.
I like working with words.
I behave in a businesslike manner.
I come up with something new.
I am not easily disturbed by events.
I rarely cry during sad movies.
I plan my life logically.
I need a creative outlet.
I make decisions based on facts, not feelings.
I make a mess of things.
I get stressed out easily.
I am romantic.
I prize logic above all else.
I often forget to put things back in their proper place.
I am calm even in tense situations.
